title: Table 64. I/O current injection susceptibility
text_helper: Table 64. I/O current injection susceptibility — section 6.3.15 I/O current injection characteristics. Symbol, Description, Functional susceptibility / Negative injection, Functional susceptibility / Positive injection, Unit.

rows: PG1, PE9, PB0, PA7, PC4, PC5, PE7, PE8, PA4, PA5, PA6, PF2, PI12, PC2_C, PC3_C, PA0_C, PA1_C, BOOT0
notes: 3. All FT_xx IO except FT_lu and FT_u.
4. VIN must be less than Max(VDDxxx) + 3.6 V.
5. Max(VDDxxx) is the maximum value of all the I/O supplies.
6. To sustain a voltage higher than MIN(VDD, VDDA, VDD33USB) +0.3 V, the internal pull-up and pull-down resistors must be disabled.
7. The pull-up and pull-down resistors are designed with a true resistance in series with a switchable PMOS/NMOS. This PMOS/NMOS contribution to the series resistance is minimal (~10%).
